rationale: A unanimous, jurisdiction-only dismissal on Clapper/Lance/Gill grounds is most likely to be assigned by the Chief to himself or to Justice Kagan as the Court’s standing specialist, with Justice Kavanaugh also a plausible author given his central Ted Cruz distinction. Separate writings are most likely from Justices Thomas/Alito/Gorsuch to emphasize separation-of-powers limits and from one of the liberal Justices to underscore practical voter impacts and the dangers of pre-election federal intervention, but the 9-0 posture makes a single majority opinion the modal outcome.
